body: I don't see why this would be related to kafka. It seems to be a bigger underlying issue.

This one is quite strange, as I said above, the warning is not triggered by other extensions

I tried these: quarkus-jaxrs-client-reactive,quarkus-resteasy-reactive,quarkus-resteasy-reactive-jackson,quarkus-resteasy-reactive-qute,quarkus-rest-client-reactive,quarkus-rest-client-reactive-jackson,core,hibernate-orm,hibernate-orm-panache,hibernate-validator,jackson,jaxb,jdbc-mysql,jdbc-postgresql,jsonb,jsonp,kubernetes-config,mailer,narayana-jta,oidc,quarkus-quartz,reactive-pg-client,scheduler,spring-boot-properties,smallrye-reactive-streams-operators,spring-data-jpa,spring-di,spring-security,spring-web,undertow,vertx,quarkus-reactive-routes,grpc,infinispan-client,cache,micrometer,micrometer-registry-prometheus,quarkus-openshift-client,quarkus-smallrye-graphql 

I noticed this when updating https://github.com/quarkus-qe/quarkus-startstop to CR2

And you need to be on Linux to notice the warning ...

We have a build here of a small quarkus application, and when trying to use CR2 instead of CR1 I also get the same warning. But as it is build inside an image, which does not have docker/podman inside it leads to a build error:
```
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal io.quarkus.platform:quarkus-maven-plugin:3.0.0.CR2:build (default) on project qcer-distribution-app: Failed to build quarkus application: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
[ERROR] 	[error]: Build step io.quarkus.deployment.pkg.steps.NativeImageBuildStep#resolveNativeImageBuildRunner threw an exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: No container runtime was found. Make sure you have either Docker or Podman installed in your environment.
```
Currently trying to determine why he is taking the new route via the NativeImageBuildStep.
Could this be a starting point: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/32236 ?
@geoand could you have a look at this one? It looks like a problematic regression.

It does look like https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/32236  is responsible and it also looks like the issue is Kafka specific (because the Kafka Client consumes `NativeImageRunnerBuildItem`).

cc @yrodiere
Let me try something real quick and see if the problem goes away
What I had in mind seems to work, opening a PR soon

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

```
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:3.0.0.CR2:build (default) on project eesk: Failed to build quarkus application: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
```
